programmes.amount_note: Almi does not publish loan amounts, interest rates or ceilings on its lending page; loans are priced individually and normally complement bank financing. No amount is recorded here rather than guessed.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous — lending, not a call. Applications are made through Almi's e-services at any time.

procedure_steps.detail: Prepare a business plan and financing need; Almi lending usually complements bank or own financing.
Log in to Almi's e-services with BankID, mobile BankID or Telia e-legitimation and complete the loan application.
Register the company before disbursement — 'Företaget behöver inte vara registrerat vid ansökningstillfället, men det måste vara registrerat innan utbetalning.'

documents_required.note: Requires BankID / mobile BankID / Telia e-legitimation

eligibility.other_note: 'Företaget behöver inte vara registrerat vid ansökningstillfället, men det måste vara registrerat innan utbetalning.' Almi is state-owned and lends on commercial terms, typically at a higher interest rate than banks to reflect risk (rate not published on the page).

programmes.source_snippet: Vi ger näring till Sverige genom att erbjuda finansiering i form av lån och riskkapital ... Företaget behöver inte vara registrerat vid ansökningstillfället, men det måste vara registrerat innan utbetalning.

programmes.amount_note: Innovation loans range from SEK 50,000 to SEK 500,000; co-financing required (part may be own work effort at lower amounts; above SEK 300,000 at least half of co-financing must be capital).
programmes.source_snippet: Innovationslån kan uppgå till minst 50 000 kronor och högst 500 000 kronor.

programmes.amount_note: Venture capital investment; Almi Invest typically co-invests with private investors on equal terms.

eligibility.other_note: Minority investments always alongside independent private co-investors. Not suited to consultancies, local small businesses, individual ideas or companies mainly seeking loans.

programmes.source_snippet: Almi Invest investerar i svenska startups i pre-seed, seed och tidig tillväxtfas.

programmes.amount_note: Up to SEK 250,000; exact amount depends on the company's needs, repayment capacity and assessed risk. Limited personal guarantee of 10% of the loan amount.
programmes.source_snippet: Med ett Mikrolån kan du låna upp till 250 000 kronor. Exakt belopp beror på ditt företags behov, återbetalningsförmåga och den risk vi bedömer att satsningen ...

programmes.name_en: Business development support for energy and climate innovations
programmes.amount_note: Grant to small companies commercialising energy/climate innovations; amounts set per call.
programmes.deadline_note: Energimyndigheten opens calls continuously; open business-development (Affärsutveckling) calls include the Sweden Sustaintech Venture Day 2026 (closes 15 Oct 2026) and India-Sweden Innovations Accelerator (closes 15 Nov 2026).
programmes.source_snippet: Energimyndigheten öppnar utlysningar löpande under året.

programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Sweden before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Sweden.

programmes.source_snippet: €50k equity free funding for product and IP development

programmes.amount_note: Investment and consultancy grants for SMEs in designated regional support areas; grant share depends on region and company size.
Maximum SEK 500,000 for validation projects and SEK 750,000 for implementation projects; total call budget SEK 22 million; minimum 25% co-financing at project level.
programmes.deadline_note: FFI ASP 2.0 2026 call is shown as closed (stängde 2 juni 2026, 14:00). The page text also mentions application periods ending 16 September and 29 October 2026 which conflicts with the closed banner; treat as closed unless Vinnova reopens.
programmes.source_snippet: Maximalt bidrag är 500 000 kronor för Valideringsprojekt och 750 000 kronor för Implementeringsprojekt. Medfinansiering på minst 25% på projektnivå är ett krav.

programmes.amount_note: 'Maximalt 500 000 kr' per project, for testing customer needs and business viability. The support percentage is not stated on the call page, so none is recorded here.
programmes.deadline_note: The 2026 call opens 12 October 2026 and closes 12 January 2027 at 14:00; decisions 23 March 2027; projects start 24 March - 1 April 2027.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that the company is a Swedish aktiebolag no more than 10 years old, with at most 10 employees and at most SEK 10 million net turnover.
Log in and complete the application in Vinnova's e-service, describing the project, the parties and the budget.
Submit before the closing time; Vinnova assesses and notifies the decision.

documents_required.doc: Application in Vinnova's e-service (project description, parties, budget)
Company registration certificate / evidence of company age, headcount and turnover

eligibility.other_note: 'Svenska aktiebolag som är högst 10 år gamla, har max 10 anställda, högst 10 mkr i nettoomsättning'. Vinnova grants of this type are commonly awarded as försumbart stöd (de minimis), but the call page text we read did not state it, so it is not asserted here.

programmes.source_snippet: Svenska aktiebolag som är högst 10 år gamla, har max 10 anställda, högst 10 mkr i nettoomsättning eller balansomslutning och ingen vinstutdelning.

programmes.name_local: Samarbetsprojekt för små och medelstora företag Sverige-Tyskland våren 2026
programmes.amount_note: Up to SEK 3 million per project from Vinnova (total Swedish budget SEK 15 million); companies are expected to co-fund their eligible costs under state-aid rules. German partners apply separately to AiF Projekt GmbH.

eligibility.other_note: SMEs with up to 499 employees in Sweden collaborating with companies and other actors in Germany; an SME must be coordinator; large companies may participate but receive no Vinnova funding. R&D activities per EU definition of industrial research and experimental development.

programmes.source_snippet: Ni kan söka upp till 3 miljoner kronor. Företag som söker förväntas medfinansiera sin stödberättigade kostnader enligt statsstödsreglerna.

programmes.name_local: Eurostars: SMF-projekt om processer, produkter och tjänster
programmes.amount_note: Up to SEK 5 million per Swedish project, but at most SEK 2 million if no Swedish SME participates. Company turnover or equity must equal at least half of the amount applied for.
programmes.deadline_note: Planerad till dec. 2026 (planned to open December 2026); exact dates not yet published.

eligibility.other_note: International cooperation project with at least one other Eurostars country; product, service or process expected on the market within two years of project end (exceptions for clinical trials and certification).

programmes.source_snippet: Eurostars riktar sig främst till innovativa små och medelstora företag som ingår i internationella projekt.

programmes.name_en: Vinnova planning grant for an international application
programmes.amount_note: Up to SEK 300,000 if you plan to participate as a project partner in an international call; up to SEK 500,000 if you plan to coordinate an international project with at least three actors from three countries.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications assessed at two occasions; final deadline 6 October 2026 at 14:00.

eligibility.other_note: Swedish SMEs (and academia, institutes, public sector, civil society) preparing an application to a published international R&I call.

programmes.source_snippet: Svenska små och medelstora företag (SMF), aktörer inom akademi, forskningsinstitut, offentlig sektor eller civilsamhälle som förbereder en ansökan till en internationell forsknings- och innovationsutlysning.

programmes.amount_note: Up to EUR 60,000 per project; co-funding of at least EUR 26,000 required. Supports feasibility assessment of commercial or research ambitions with a local partner in Asia, Africa, Oceania and the Americas.

eligibility.other_note: Innovative Swedish SMEs wanting to explore new international markets in Asia, Africa, Oceania and the Americas together with a local partner (supplier, research actor or technology developer).

programmes.source_snippet: Stöd till innovativa små eller medelstora företag för att bedöma genomförbarheten av era forsknings- eller kommersiella ambitioner på internationella marknader.

programmes.amount_note: Loan of up to SEK 10 million; Almi normally finances 30-50% of the capital need alongside co-financing (e.g. owners, bank); term 12-84 months; EIF guarantee allows longer term, initial amortisation holiday and lower interest than Almi's other loans.

eligibility.other_note: Innovative limited companies (aktiebolag) registered in Sweden with up to 250 employees that are in or approaching growth; normally requires co-financing; typical security is a business mortgage plus limited personal guarantee.

programmes.source_snippet: Tillväxtlån är ett lån för innovativa små och medelstora aktiebolag, som är i eller står inför tillväxt och som vill växa snabbare än vad den egna ekonomin eller den ordinarie bankfinansieringen klarar.

programmes.amount_note: Loan of up to SEK 20 million for green transition investments; requires co-financing (Almi normally finances 30-50% of the capital need); term 12-120 months; EIF guarantee enables more favourable terms.

eligibility.other_note: Companies registered in Sweden with up to 250 employees whose investment meets at least one sustainability criterion linked to the EU taxonomy.

programmes.source_snippet: Grönt lån är ett lån från Almi som hjälper små och medelstora företag att finansiera satsningar som bidrar till grön omställning och miljönytta.

programmes.amount_note: Loan for investments, production, stock, customer financing and other export-related costs; amount set by financing need and repayment ability; Almi normally finances 30-50% of the capital need; term around 2-5 years; can be combined with EKN guarantees.

eligibility.other_note: Companies registered in Sweden (SMEs) with a clear plan to expand internationally; established companies particularly; normally requires co-financing; security usually business mortgage plus limited personal guarantee.

programmes.source_snippet: Exportlån är ett lån från Almi som hjälper företag att satsa på internationella marknader.

programmes.amount_note: First investment typically SEK 10-50 million, with possibility to invest significantly more later; smaller pre-seed investments for exceptional opportunities. Focus areas: life science, deep tech, software and growth.
programmes.deadline_note: No fixed deadline; founders can contact the fund early.

eligibility.other_note: Focus is Sweden but reach extends across the Nordics and Baltics; invests alongside local co-investors. Equity investment, not a grant.

programmes.source_snippet: Vi investerar i bolag i ett tidigt skede. Vår första investering ligger vanligtvis på 10–50 miljoner SEK, med möjlighet att investera betydligt mer under bolagets fortsatta utveckling.
